content.comment_body: Is there a way to select specific days of the week in [product_name] Web Editor? For example, can we add checkboxes for each day—Monday through Sunday—in the editor? An example showing how to do this using checkboxes or a similar method would be very helpful. Alternatively, could a latching switch be used to achieve this?

The day of the week is stored as an integer in variable VB998 (where 0 is Sunday, 1 is Monday, and so on up to 6 for Saturday). However, VB998 is not accessible within [product_name] Web Editor, and can only be accessed by other remote devices such as [product_name] HMIs or controllers.

analysis.insight_summary: Users want a straightforward way to select specific weekdays interactively within [product_name] Web Editor, ideally with checkboxes. However, direct access to the relevant system variable for the day of the week is restricted, which limits how users can configure this functionality and reduces the editor’s flexibility.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to select individual weekdays directly using checkboxes or similar UI elements in [product_name] Web Editor for use in logic operations.
